authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4855.2 *cucci explicitly lists Bashkarik čič and Hindi/Nepali cūcī/cuci breast or nipple. Their i-bearing series selects section 2, not *cuccu; the family is expressive. Exact survey form cūcī is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3103 kāleyaka expressly discusses the heart/liver semantic overlap and gives Hindi karejā heart/liver, Assamese kɔlizā heart and Gujarati kāḷjũ heart/liver. The survey kalja/kaleja/kareja heart words fit this explicitly documented sense family. Exact survey form karejā is preserved.
